system.description:
You have 10 [inventory slots]. [Trigger: Text] You use this when you use a [consumable] item, or when you lose it as a result of the "Consumption Table". One of the items remains without being lost. Once per scenario. Space Bag Common Consumable A special bag created by the renowned magic artisan Dazneck for travelers on a harsh path. The interior space is expanded, allowing for an enormous capacity that cannot be imagined from its appearance. The weight of its contents is completely imperceptible.

Purple Flame Crystal [Core Material] (120G) + Wyvern Wing Membrane [Valuable] (110G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (280G)
